source.title: The Blade Reformed
source.description:
I think I've got the alloy to a point here we can reliably use it to craft a blade's billet. Fortunately, we also have plenty of raw materials with everything you've gathered for me so far.

Stand back if you would. Working the forge can be... dramatic.
source.completion:
It's done. While my lightforged alloy is a product of holy magic, this blade in its current form is just that; a simple blade. Putting the rest of the pieces back together is on you and your ghostly friend.

I haven't felt this accomplished in a while, but I have to confess that I have a bad feeling about all of this. I wonder if maybe it would have been better to let the Ashbringer stay broken. This feels wrong, like maybe this wasn't supposed to happen.
